source_brief_reference: Create a short educational explainer video about how an AI production pipeline checks generated frames before assembly. The video should be clear, practical, and suitable for beginners.
visual_intent: Show the structured nature of automated QA
composition_requirements: Animated flowchart showing frames entering the QA pipeline and moving through sequential check stations.
camera_framing_requirements: Wide establishing shot of QA pipeline flowchart
subject_object_requirements: QA pipeline stations with entry/exit flow
qa_criteria: checkpoints clearly defined, flow direction intuitive
